$comment: Ready-to-paste JSON-LD templates for active (non-deprecated) Schema.org types as of February 2026. Schema.org version 29.4 (December 2025). Replace [BRACKETED] placeholders with real values. Use only types listed here — see schema-types-status.md for deprecation status. Always wrap in <script type="application/ld+json">...</script> in the page <head>.

$conventions.ssr: Render server-side for time-sensitive markup (Product, Offer, Article). JS-injected schema may face delayed processing per Google's December 2025 JS SEO guidance
$conventions.absolute_urls: All URLs must be absolute, not relative
$conventions.iso_dates: All dates in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or full timestamp)
$conventions.graph_for_multiple: Use @graph to combine multiple schema types on one page

Organization.description: Company info. Use on homepage or about page. Required for knowledge panel eligibility.

WebSite.description: Site-level info. Use on homepage. Enables sitelinks search box if SearchAction is included.

BreadcrumbList.description: Navigation breadcrumbs. Use on every nested page. Strong rich result eligibility.

WebPage.description: Generic page-level metadata. Use as base type when no more specific type fits.

ContactPage.description: Contact page. Subtype of WebPage with contact-specific semantics.

Person.description: Author or team member. Use for author bylines and team pages. Strong E-E-A-T signal.

ProfilePage.description: Author or creator profile page. Wrap a Person in mainEntity. Added 2025. Strong E-E-A-T signal.

Article.description: Generic article. Use for any editorial content.

BlogPosting.description: Blog post. Same fields as Article but with blog context.

NewsArticle.description: News article. Required for Google News inclusion.
NewsArticle.richResults: News rich result, Top stories carousel

DiscussionForumPosting.description: Forum or community thread. Added 2024. Use for forum/discussion content.

Book.description: Book pages. Includes editions and authors.

Dataset.$note: Rich results retired late 2025, but schema is still valid for AI/LLM citation and Google Dataset Search internal use.

FAQPage.$note: RESTRICTED for Google rich results: only government and healthcare authority sites since August 2023. STILL useful for AI/LLM citation visibility (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews).
FAQPage.description: FAQ section. Use only on gov/health sites for Google rich results, OR on commercial sites for AI/LLM citation benefit (NOT for Google rich result expectations).

SoftwareApplication.description: Generic software application. Use for desktop apps, mobile apps, SaaS.
SoftwareApplication.richResults: App rich result with rating and pricing

template.name: [App Name]
template.description: [One-sentence description of what the app does]

MobileApplication.description: Mobile-only apps (iOS, Android). Subtype of SoftwareApplication.

SoftwareSourceCode.description: Open source repositories or code pages. Added 2025.

Product.description: Physical or digital product. Required for product rich results.

ProductGroup.description: Product variants grouped by attributes (size, color). Added 2025. Required for variant-aware rich results.

Offer.description: Standalone offer (use inline with Product usually).

OfferShippingDetails.description: Shipping and delivery info. Use inline with Offer.

MerchantReturnPolicy.description: Return policy. Required by Google March 2025 for product rich results: returnPolicyCountry must be set.

AggregateRating.description: Summary of multiple reviews. Use inline with Product, SoftwareApplication, etc.

Certification.description: Product certifications (Energy Star, organic, safety). Replaced EnergyConsumptionDetails April 2025.

LoyaltyProgram.description: Member pricing, loyalty cards. Added June 2025.

VideoObject.description: Video content. Required for video rich results.
VideoObject.richResults: Video thumbnail in SERP, video carousel

BroadcastEvent.description: Live streaming. Required for LIVE badge in Google Search.

Clip.description: Video chapters / key moments. Enables timestamp links in SERP.

SeekToAction.description: Enables seek functionality in video rich results.

ImageObject.description: Standalone image pages or image metadata.

Event.description: Generic event. Use for conferences, meetups, webinars.

ConferenceEvent.description: Conference subtype of Event. Added December 2025 (Schema.org v29.4).

PerformingArtsEvent.description: Concerts, plays, dance performances. Added December 2025 (Schema.org v29.4).

Recipe.description: Cooking recipes. Required for recipe rich results.
Recipe.richResults: Recipe card with ratings, time, image

local_business.$note: LocalBusiness has many subtypes (Restaurant, Dentist, Lawyer, Plumber, AutoRepair, etc.). Use the most specific subtype that fits.

LocalBusiness.description: Generic physical business. Use a more specific subtype if available.
LocalBusiness.richResults: Business info in maps and SERP

JobPosting.description: Job listings. Required for Google for Jobs inclusion.

template.title: [Job Title]
template.description: [Full job description, including requirements and responsibilities]

template.name: [Course Name]
template.description: [Course description and what students will learn]

MedicalWebPage.description: Medical content pages. YMYL — requires high E-E-A-T.

Speakable.description: Marks content as suitable for voice search / Google Assistant audio playback.

multiple_types_example.$comment: Combine multiple schema types on one page using @graph. Use @id to reference between them.
